Shiv Sena (UBT) Leader Sachin Ahir Joins Shinde Faction

Shiv Sena (UBT) legislator Sachin Ahir has joined the Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena faction, marking another setback for Uddhav Thackeray. This move follows reports of six Shiv Sena MPs switching sides. Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde welcomed Ahir, calling him a grassroots leader whose inclusion would strengthen the Shiv Sena. Aditya Thackeray has reportedly reacted to Ahir's departure.
